title: The club
localNote: For now, the club lives on this device. Sharing it between your staff's phones and computers needs accounts, which are on the roadmap.

empty.title: Bring your teams together in a club
empty.body: The club gathers all your teams, your staff, your videos and your players' profiles, with one game model.

form.crestHint: The crest is drawn from the club's colours and initials.
form.name: Club name
form.applyColors_one: Give these colours to the club's team
form.applyColors_other: Give these colours to the club's {{count}} teams
form.aboutPh: Who you are, in two sentences.
form.modelPh: How all your teams play with the ball, without it, and in transition.
form.modelHint: Shared by every team: it appears in the analysis and on public profiles.

overview.modelEmpty: No game model yet. Write in a few lines how all your teams should play.
overview.modelShared: The same text for every team, from the youth sides to the seniors.
overview.planNote: Your current plan: {{plan}}. The full club space is part of the Club plan, {{price}} a month. Nothing is locked during the demo.
overview.noTeams: The club has no team yet. Create one in the Teams tab.

needs.players: Add the squad: the team has no players yet.
needs.code: Code a first match, live or on video, to start the season's Indice.
needs.weak: Weak point of the season: {{sub}} ({{v}} out of 20). One to work on this week.

teams.newHint: In the club's colours, with the same game model.
teams.name: Team name
teams.colorsHint: The team takes the club's colours.
teams.noStaff: No staff yet: invite a coach.

members.empty: Nobody yet. Invite your staff, your players and the parents.
members.removeBody: {{name}} will no longer be part of the club on this device. Their videos and player data stay in place.

rights.title: Who sees what
rights.lead: Each role opens precise rights: which videos they see, coding, analytics and running the club.
rights.note: These rights will apply once accounts let the club be shared across several devices.

invite.title: Invite to the club
invite.name: Full name
invite.emailHint: Optional: to prepare the email message.

roleHint.admin: Runs the club, its teams and members. Sees every video.
roleHint.coach: Codes and analyses the videos of their teams.
roleHint.analyst: Codes and analyses every video of the club.
roleHint.player: Sees the clips they appear in and their journey.

invite.readyBody: Send this link yourself, by WhatsApp, email or text message. Ndamba sends nothing on your behalf.
invite.honest: For now, the link opens Ndamba on the person's phone. Joining the club automatically will come with accounts: until then, mark the member as active once they have joined.
invite.subject: Invitation: {{club}} on Ndamba
invite.message: Hello {{name}}, I'm inviting you to join {{club}} on Ndamba with the {{role}} role. Open this link on your phone: {{link}}

videos.lead_one: {{count}} video in the club, across all teams.
videos.lead_other: {{count}} videos in the club, across all teams.
videos.empty: No video yet. Add a YouTube or Facebook link, a file, or upload the video to Ndamba.

players.clubOn_one: On: {{count}} public profile. Each player stays private until you open their profile.
players.clubOn_other: On: {{count}} public profiles. Each player stays private until you open their profile.
players.clubOff: Off: no profile is visible, even those marked public.
players.empty: No players in the club's teams yet.
players.note: A complete profile needs no photo: number, position, foot, year of birth, height, a short bio, video clips and contributions to the Indice.

analytics.title: The club in numbers, season {{season}}
analytics.lead: The Indice Njangi of each team from its coded matches. To compare matches, players and clips, open the analysis studio.
analytics.compareHint: Out of 100. The marks show the bands: 35, 50, 65 and 80.
analytics.subsHint: Out of 20. In red, each team's weak point.
analytics.commonBody: On average, the club's teams score {{v}} out of 20 in {{sub}}. One piece of work for every age group, with these drills from the Njangi Code:

recruit.title: Recruitment profile
recruit.notFoundBody: This player does not exist on this device.
recruit.publicOn: Visible to anyone with the link, on this device for now.
recruit.publicOff: Private: only the club sees it.
recruit.clubClosed: The club does not allow public profiles yet.
recruit.bioPh: Their game, their qualities, what they are looking for (academy, scholarship, club).
recruit.bioHint: {{n}} characters. Three or four sentences are enough.
recruit.clipsHint: Pick up to {{n}} clips from the club's videos.
recruit.noClips: No clips yet. Pick moments from the club's videos.
recruit.noClipsAtAll: No video of the club has clips yet. Create clips in the video studio.

season.sharesHint_one: Share of the team's actions over {{count}} coded match. Full bar at 25%.
season.sharesHint_other: Share of the team's actions over {{count}} coded matches. Full bar at 25%.
season.noEvents: No coded action for this player this season yet.

clip.gone: This video can no longer be played in this browser.
clip.onDevice: Clip from a video kept on the club's device: it cannot be played here.
clip.facebook: Clip from {{from}} to {{to}}, to watch on Facebook.

public.title: Player profile
public.hiddenBody: The club has not opened this profile, or it does not exist on this device. For now, a profile link only works on the club's device.
public.seasonHint: Figures from the matches the club coded with the Njangi method.
public.deviceNote: This link works on this device only, until Ndamba accounts arrive. The data comes from the club and is not verified by Ndamba.

join.title: Invitation to {{club}}
join.honest: Today the club's data lives on the club's device: this link is a way to confirm the invitation with the person who sent it. Accounts, which will let you join the club from your own phone, are on the roadmap.
join.unknownTitle: Invitation not found on this device
join.unknown: This invitation was created on a club's device. Until accounts exist, it only opens there. Ask the club's manager to show you the club space.
